questions.question: King David wanted to build something for God, but God said no. What did David want to build?

answers.text: A house for the ark of the covenant
A palace of cedar for himself
A wall around all of Jerusalem

questions.question: Why did God tell King David he would not be the one to build the house for God's Name?

answers.text: He was a man of war who shed blood
He was too old to see it finished
He did not ask the priests first

questions.question: Out of all of King David's many sons, which one did the LORD choose to sit on the throne of Israel?
God promised to establish King Solomon's kingdom forever, on one condition. What was the condition?

answers.text: He resolutely carries out God's commandments
He finishes building the house quickly
He defeats every enemy around Israel
